examples.chinese: 這是我朋友送我的生日卡片。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ péngyou sòng wǒ de shēngrì kǎpiàn.
examples.english: This is the birthday card my friend gave me.

examples.chinese: 莫以凡寫了一張卡片，感謝台灣朋友對他的幫助。
examples.pinyin: Mò Yǐfán xiě le yì zhāng kǎpiàn, gǎnxiè Táiwān péngyǒu duì tā de bāngzhù.
examples.english: Mo Yifan wrote a card to thank his Taiwanese friends for their help.

examples.chinese:
張太太上個月生了一個女兒，我寫了一張卡片祝福她，希望孩子快快樂樂地長大。
我的孩子滿月時，收到很多朋友送的禮物和滿滿的祝福。
examples.pinyin:
Zhāng tàitai shàng ge yuè shēng le yí ge nǚ'ér, wǒ xiě le yì zhāng kǎpiàn zhùfú tā, xīwàng háizi kuàikuàilèlè de zhǎngdà.
Wǒ de háizi mǎnyuè shí, shōudào hěn duō péngyou sòng de lǐwù hé mǎnmǎn de zhùfú.
examples.english:
Mrs. Zhang gave birth to a daughter last month. I wrote a card to bless her, hoping the child will grow up happily.
When my child was one month old, we received many gifts from friends and full blessings.

examples.chinese: 我男朋友親手做了一張卡片，還買了一個漂亮的背包送給我， 他的心意讓我很感動。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ nánpéngyou qīnshǒu zuò le yì zhāng kǎpiàn, hái mǎi le yí ge piàoliang de bēibāo sòng gěi wǒ, tā de xīnyì ràng wǒ hěn gǎndòng.
examples.english: My boyfriend personally made a card and also bought a beautiful backpack to give me; his kindly feelings moved me very much.

examples.chinese: 不斷複習生字卡片能幫我們記住新的字。
examples.pinyin: Bùduàn fùxí shēngzì kǎpiàn néng bāng wǒmen jìzhù xīn de zì.
examples.english: Constantly reviewing vocabulary flashcards can help us remember new characters.

items.wordHook: 卡(card) + 片(flat piece) → a flat card: 卡片(card).

examples.chinese: 在夜市買東西的時候，有些人會跟老闆殺價。
examples.pinyin: Zài yèshì mǎi dōngxi de shíhou, yǒuxiē rén huì gēn lǎobǎn shājià.
examples.english: When shopping at the night market, some people will bargain with the vendor.

examples.chinese: 那件名牌長裙才兩千元而已，用不著跟老闆殺價。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiàn míngpái chángqún cái liǎngqiān yuán éryǐ, yòngbuzháo gēn lǎobǎn shājià.
examples.english: That brand-name long skirt is only two thousand yuan, that's all; there's no need to haggle with the shopkeeper.

examples.chinese: 我把搭車的日期、時間都記下來了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ dā chē de rìqī, shíjiān dōu jì xiàlái le.
examples.english: I have written down the date and time of the train ride.

examples.chinese: 把考試的日期記在手機裡，這樣做就不會忘了。
examples.pinyin: Bǎ kǎoshì de rìqī jì zài shǒujī lǐ, zhèyàng zuò jiù bù huì wàng le.
examples.english: Record the exam date in your phone; doing it this way, you won't forget.

examples.chinese:
氣象預報人員確定明天颱風會來，我們最好去超市買一些泡麵、雞蛋。
老闆要我照確定的日期去南部出差，如果有什麼改變，他會早點兒通知我。
examples.pinyin:
Qìxiàng yùbào rényuán quèdìng míngtiān táifēng huì lái, wǒmen zuìhǎo qù chāoshì mǎi yìxiē pàomiàn, jīdàn.
Lǎobǎn yào wǒ zhào quèdìng de rìqī qù nánbù chūchāi, rúguǒ yǒu shénme gǎibiàn, tā huì zǎodiǎnr tōngzhī wǒ.
examples.english:
The weather forecasters are sure that the typhoon will come tomorrow; we'd better go to the supermarket to buy some instant noodles and eggs.
The boss wants me to go on a business trip to the south according to the confirmed date; if there are any changes, he will notify me earlier.

examples.chinese: A:為什麼活動中心連一個人都沒有？今天不是有吉他社的表演嗎？ B:你搞錯了，演出日期是下個星期三。
examples.pinyin: A: Wèishénme huódòng zhōngxīn lián yí ge rén dōu méiyǒu? Jīntiān bú shì yǒu jítā shè de biǎoyǎn ma? B: Nǐ gǎo cuò le, yǎnchū rìqī shì xià ge xīngqīsān.
examples.english: A: Why is there not a single person at the activity center? Isn't there a guitar club performance today? B: You got it wrong; the performance date is next Wednesday.

examples.chinese: 他在超市隨手買了瓶飲料，回家後才發現有效日期快到了，只好趕快喝完。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài chāoshì suíshǒu mǎi le píng yǐnliào, huí jiā hòu cái fāxiàn yǒuxiào rìqī kuài dào le, zhǐhǎo gǎnkuài hē wán.
examples.english: He conveniently bought a bottle of drink at the supermarket, and only after getting home did he discover that the expiration date was almost up, so he had no choice but to hurry and finish drinking it.

items.key: ["B2L14-1-37","年年有餘","年年有餘","年年有余","Ph"]

examples.chinese:
付錢的時候，他從皮包裡抽出一張信用卡交給店員。
他參加百貨公司的活動，抽到一台價格六萬元的平板電腦， 真是太幸運了！
examples.pinyin:
Fù qián de shíhou, tā cóng píbāo lǐ chōu chū yī zhāng xìnyòngkǎ jiāo gěi diànyuán.
Tā cānjiā bǎihuò gōngsī de huódòng, chōu dào yī tái jiàgé liù wàn yuán de píngbǎn diànnǎo, zhēn shì tài xìngyùn le!
examples.english:
When paying, he took out a credit card from his wallet and handed it to the clerk.
He participated in a department store event and drew a tablet computer worth 60,000 yuan; he was really so lucky!

examples.chinese: 自從有了抽號機以後，人們就不需要站著排隊了。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng yǒu le chōuhàojī yǐhòu, rénmen jiù bù xūyào zhànzhe páiduì le.
examples.english: Ever since there have been queue ticket dispensers, people no longer need to stand in line.

items.wordHook: A 扌(hand) pulls a 由(cause) out of the pile: 抽(take out).

examples.chinese: 九二一大地震時，臺灣人發揮了互相幫助的精神，讓人非常感動。
examples.pinyin: Jiǔ'èr yī dà dìzhèn shí, Táiwān rén fāhuī le hùxiāng bāngzhù de jīngshén, ràng rén fēicháng gǎndòng.
examples.english: During the 921 earthquake, Taiwanese people brought out the spirit of helping one another, which was very moving.

examples.chinese: 發生大地震後，民眾都發揮愛心，主動提供救災的相關用品給災民。
examples.pinyin: Fāshēng dà dìzhèn hòu, mínzhòng dōu fāhuī àixīn, zhǔdòng tígōng jiùzāi de xiāngguān yòngpǐn gěi zāimín.
examples.english: After the major earthquake, people showed compassion and proactively provided disaster-relief related supplies to the victims.

examples.chinese: 學生：明天就要大學考試了，我很緊張，怕考不好。 老師：你是很優秀的學生，我相信只要盡自己的能力，好好發揮實力，一定沒問題的。
examples.pinyin: Xuéshēng: Míngtiān jiù yào dàxué kǎoshì le, wǒ hěn jǐnzhāng, pà kǎo bù hǎo. Lǎoshī: Nǐ shì hěn yōuxiù de xuéshēng, wǒ xiāngxìn zhǐyào jìn zìjǐ de nénglì, hǎohǎo fāhuī shílì, yīdìng méi wèntí de.
examples.english: Student: The university exam is tomorrow; I'm very nervous and afraid I won't do well. Teacher: You are an excellent student; I believe that as long as you do your best according to your ability and fully demonstrate your strength, there will definitely be no problem.

examples.chinese: 假如人人都發揮人性美好的一面，就能給社會帶來和平。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎrú rénrén dōu fāhuī rénxìng měihǎo de yī miàn, jiù néng gěi shèhuì dàilái hépíng.
examples.english: If everyone brings out the beautiful side of human nature, then it can bring peace to society.

examples.chinese: 前主任一天到晚做研究，連周末也不休息，這樣身體怎麼受得了？
examples.pinyin: Qián zhǔrèn yītiāndàowǎn zuò yánjiū, lián zhōumò yě bù xiūxi, zhèyàng shēntǐ zěnme shòudeliǎo?
examples.english: The former director did research all day long, not even resting on weekends; how could his body endure that?

items.wordHook: Combining 主(master) and 任(trust): 主任 means chief.

examples.chinese: 在臺灣，碰到緊急情況可撥110，請警察提供協助。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, pèngdào jǐnjí qíngkuàng kě bō 110, qǐng jǐngchá tígōng xiézhù.
examples.english: In Taiwan, when encountering an emergency, you can dial 110 to ask the police for assistance.

examples.chinese: 我每天睡覺前都會把明天的早餐預備好，這樣一起床只要加熱就能吃了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān shuìjiào qián dōu huì bǎ míngtiān de zǎocān yùbèi hǎo, zhèyàng yī qǐchuáng zhǐyào jiārè jiù néng chī le.
examples.english: Every day before going to bed, I prepare tomorrow's breakfast, so that as soon as I get up, I just need to heat it up and can eat.

examples.chinese: 哥哥只要睡前喝太多水，就會夢到半夜起床找不到廁所，這樣的夢真可怕！
examples.pinyin: Gēge zhǐyào shuì qián hē tài duō shuǐ, jiù huì mèng dào bànyè qǐchuáng zhǎo bù dào cèsuǒ, zhèyàng de mèng zhēn kěpà!
examples.english: As long as my older brother drinks too much water before bed, he dreams of getting up in the middle of the night and not being able to find the toilet; such a dream is really scary!

examples.chinese: 爸爸每天早上一起床就看報紙。
examples.pinyin: Bàba měitiān zǎoshang yì qǐchuáng jiù kàn bàozhǐ.
examples.english: Every morning as soon as Dad gets out of bed, he reads the newspaper.

examples.chinese: A:你每天幾點起床？ B:差不多七點。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ měi tiān jǐ diǎn qǐchuáng? B: Chàbuduō qī diǎn.
examples.english: A: What time do you get up every day? B: About seven o'clock.

examples.chinese: 我平常早上七點起床，八點吃早飯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ píngcháng zǎoshang qī diǎn qǐchuáng, bā diǎn chī zǎofàn.
examples.english: I usually get up at seven and have breakfast at eight in the morning.

examples.chinese: 哥哥喜歡在床上看書。
examples.pinyin: Gēge xǐhuān zài chuáng shàng kànshū.
examples.english: My elder brother likes to read in bed.

examples.chinese: 我今天七點起床。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān qī diǎn qǐchuáng.
examples.english: I get up at 7:00 today.

items.wordHook: Under a 广(broad) roof rests a 木(tree) frame → the 床(bed).

examples.chinese: 每個人都有不小心發生錯誤的時候，不需要取笑別人。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu yǒu bù xiǎoxīn fāshēng cuòwù de shíhou, bù xūyào qǔxiào biérén.
examples.english: Everyone has times when they accidentally make mistakes; there is no need to make fun of others.

items.wordHook: a 亠(lid) drops onto a 父(father) and locks them together → 交(connect).
Combining 同(same) and 時(time): 同時 means at the same time.
Combining 密(secret) and 碼(number): 密碼 means password.
百(hundred) + 貨(products) + 公司(company) → a company with hundreds of products: department store.
Words in 言(speech) that miss the mark: 誤(error).
